name: @dragonfsky/oracle-relay
description: CLI wrapper around OpenAI Responses API with GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5 Pro, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.1, and GPT-5.1 Codex high reasoning modes.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm run build:mcp-surface && pnpm run build:vendor && pnpm run build:bin-modes
scripts.build:client:windows: dotnet publish apps/relay-operator-windows/OracleRelayOperator.Windows.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true --output artifacts/windows
scripts.build:mcp-surface: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const old=['dist/src/mcp/server.js','dist/src/mcp/consultPresets.js','dist/src/mcp/types.js','dist/src/mcp/utils.js','dist/src/mcp/tools']; for (const target of old) fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.build:vendor: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const vendorRoot=path.join('dist','vendor'); fs.rmSync(vendorRoot,{recursive:true,force:true}); const vendors=[['oracle-notifier']]; vendors.forEach(([name])=>{const src=path.join('vendor',name); const dest=path.join(vendorRoot,name); fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true,force:true});}});"
scripts.build:bin-modes: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); for(const target of Object.values(pkg.bin||{})){if(fs.existsSync(target))fs.chmodSync(target,0o775)}"
scripts.check: pnpm run check:secrets && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint
